body.name: Finite orbit-game constructions
body.construction: Let \(\pi\) range over laws on arm-count vectors \(r\) with \(\sum_ar_a=n\), and let \(\delta(r,x)\in[-1,1]\). Define \(G_n^{\mathrm{all}}=\inf_{\pi,\delta}\max_{m\in\mathcal M_n}\sum_r\pi_r\sum_xP_m(x\mid r)\{\delta(r,x)-n^{-1}\sum_tm_t\mu(t)\}^2\). Define \(G_n^{\mathrm{iid}}(q)\) by fixing \(\pi_r=n!\prod_aq_a^{r_a}/\prod_ar_a!\).
